entries.5c841cb430b981c0: The group consists of the company and four consolidated subsidiaries, engaging in the manufacture and sale of industrial measurement and control equipment, environmental measurement and analysis equipment, measurement and inspection equipment and industrial machinery, along with services and other business. The company treats these as a single segment because of the similarity in the nature of its products and sales markets. Consolidated subsidiary Futaba Tech handles the manufacture of industrial measurement and control equipment and industrial machinery, among others; Tobu Kiki handles sales in the Tohoku region, engineering services, and electrical and instrumentation work; and the subsidiaries in Shanghai and Taiwan sell in their respective markets. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥48,846 million, and consolidated employees numbered 400.
entries.6c06703c037e6e87: Equipment used for measurement and control in factories and plants, such as process measurement and control equipment and various sensors. Sales grew for various sensors for the shipbuilding industry and process measurement and control equipment for the chemical, steel, and construction and plant industries. The company also proposes solutions such as visualization of equipment status and remote monitoring. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,044 million.
entries.8d45124fe8ee71fa: Industrial machinery such as valves and specialized vehicles used in the social infrastructure field. Sales of valves for the shipbuilding industry increased, while sales of specialized vehicles declined due to effects such as delays in shipments of truck chassis. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥19,562 million.
entries.b5710d5215d146b1: Measurement and inspection equipment used for high-precision, high-quality product development and maintaining quality control systems. Demand was seen from the steel industry, while large projects for the chemical industry came to an end, and overall sales declined. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,704 million.
entries.d3f4ba571c73e4db: A company that sells industrial measurement and control instruments, industrial machinery and other equipment to factories and plants in the chemical, steel, shipbuilding and other industries.
entries.dc2037262cb68fd9: Manufacturers of production machinery and electrical equipment
entries.e7921ec516b3446b: Industrial Measurement and Control Equipment and Industrial Machinery Business
entries.f390ab227655151b: Measurement and analysis equipment used for reducing environmental impact, complying with regulations and improving equipment safety, such as water quality meters, air analyzers and vibration meters. The company also provides operational support through periodic maintenance after delivery. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,533 million.
